stem: The Period 3 elements show trends in physical and chemical properties across the period.

parts.label: (a)(i)
parts.text: Explain the trend shown in the atomic radii of the Period 3 elements $\text{Na}$ to $\text{Cl}$.

parts.label: (a)(ii)
parts.text: Explain why there is a large difference in the ionic radii of $\text{Al}$ and $\text{P}$.

parts.label: (b)(i)

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text: State why there is no data given in row B for $\text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ and $\text{SiO}_2$.

parts.label: (c)(i)
parts.text: Write an equation for the reaction of $\text{Na}_2\text{O}$ with dilute hydrochloric acid.

parts.label: (c)(ii)
parts.text: Construct an equation for the reaction of $\text{Al}_2\text{O}_3$ with a base to form $\text{NaAlO}_2$.

parts.label: (d)(i)
parts.stem: Group 2 nitrates decompose on heating to form oxides.
parts.text: State the trend in thermal stability of the Group 2 nitrates down the group.

parts.label: (d)(ii)
parts.text: Identify the other products of the thermal decomposition of Group 2 nitrates.
